## 📦 Developer info [![Automatic tests level](https://apps.yunohost.org/badge/cilevel/cubiks-2048)](https://ci-apps.yunohost.org/ci/apps/cubiks-2048/) 🛠️ Upstream Cubiks 2048 repository: Pull request are welcome and should target the [`testing` branch](https://github.com/YunoHost-Apps/cubiks-2048_ynh/tree/testing). The `testing` branch can be tested using: ``` # fresh install: sudo yunohost app install https://github.com/YunoHost-Apps/cubiks-2048_ynh/tree/testing # upgrade an existing install: sudo yunohost app upgrade cubiks-2048 -u https://github.com/YunoHost-Apps/cubiks-2048_ynh/tree/testing ``` ### 📚 App packaging documentation Please see for more information.
